summary: Iteration 4 backend-only regression PASSED (9/9) covering all 5 shipped tasks. Verified: (1) /api/stories returns 35 stories including s01..s30, burn_notice, falling_for_the_enigma; burn_notice.coverUrl ends with /api/media/cover_burn_notice.png and HTTP 200 (684KB); all 30 s01..s30 have exactly 3 endings and status=coming_soon. (2) POST /api/endings/record for burn_notice:burn_burn returns ok:true + int rarityPercent + endingUnlockTimes containing a fresh ISO timestamp for the key; /api/auth/me confirms both ownedEndings and endingUnlockTimes are updated. (3) POST /api/endings/share {surface:ending_wall_banner} increments shareCount monotonically 1→2→3, persists to endingShareCounts on /me, AND inserts one db.analytics_events row per call with event=share_card_shared and matching props (verified directly via motor: 3 rows with props.storyId=burn_notice, endingId=burn_burn, surface=ending_wall_banner, shareCount 1/2/3). (4) POST /api/analytics still accepts arbitrary events with & without auth. (5) chapter unlock/complete + choice flows unchanged (fresh user unlocked ch0-2, made free choice on c3m5, completed ch2 → returned serverTime & unlocksAt).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py share_ending() correctly updates endingShareCounts and inserts an analytics_events row atomically (two writes, but safe ordering: user first, then event log). Payload shape matches frontend expectation (shareCount top-level plus endingShareCounts map).
record_ending() always refreshes endingUnlockTimes[key] on every completion — this is the intended behavior for the 'JUST UNLOCKED' banner rotation and also back-patches legacy users. Good.
burn_notice cover is served from /api/media/cover_burn_notice.png (684KB, valid PNG) — coverUrl in the story doc matches manifest.covers.burn_notice.
server.py is now 933 lines (was 872 in iter3). Still recommend splitting into routers for maintainability, but non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: not tested this iteration (backend-only per request)

seed_data_creation: Used seeded test user test1@delulu.dev with fallback signup. Test also creates a throwaway user for the chapter/choice smoke to keep flagship progress clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 iter4 tasks pass regression. Endpoints validated: GET /api/stories (35 stories), GET /api/stories/burn_notice (coverUrl + 3 endings + coming_soon), GET /api/stories/s01..s30 (each has 3 endings, status=coming_soon), POST /api/endings/record (endingUnlockTimes + rarityPercent), POST /api/endings/share (shareCount monotonic + analytics_events row with event=share_card_shared and matching props), POST /api/analytics (auth + no-auth), POST /api/chapters/unlock+complete, POST /api/progress/choice. MongoDB direct check confirmed analytics_events rows are persisted with the exact shape the frontend fires.
